about.title: About — zsapping.net
about.description: About zsapping.net — independent education and infrastructure for freedom tech.
about.headline: Quiet work on freedom tech.

body.p1: zsapping.net exists to make freedom tech approachable — without the noise, the speculation, or the cliques.
body.p2: The work is split between education and infrastructure: helping people understand Bitcoin and Nostr well enough to make their own decisions, and operating the kind of relay infrastructure those decisions rely on.
body.p3: There is no team page, no roadmap deck, no funding round. Just careful work on a small set of things, done in the open.

body.intro: zsapping.net is a small, content-driven website. We collect as little as possible.

what.p: We do not run any analytics or tracking scripts on this site. Standard server logs may record an IP address and request metadata for short periods to operate the service and detect abuse.

email.p: If you email us, we keep the email so we can respond. We don't add you to any mailing list.

cookies.p: We don't set tracking cookies. Your browser may store a language preference locally so the site remembers it on your next visit.

contact.p: If you have any privacy questions, email hello@zsapping.net.

body.intro: By using zsapping.net, you agree to the following terms. They are intentionally short.

use.p: Use the site and any services we provide lawfully. Don't attempt to disrupt or abuse our infrastructure.

content.p: Educational content on this site is provided in good faith and for general information. It is not financial, legal, or tax advice.

warranty.p: Services are provided as-is, without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for losses arising from your use of the site or services.

changes.p: We may update these terms over time. The latest version always lives at this URL.
